//: The headless scenario runner. Compiles src and headless together into
tmp/headless, which the scenario-run workflow then executes with node.
Separate from tsconfig.json for the same reason tsconfig.test.json is: the
site output must contain the application and nothing else. A batch entry
point that reads files, spawns a database client and writes a job summary
has no business in a browser, and keeping it out of `include` there is what
makes that structural rather than a rule somebody has to remember.
It compiles the same src/ modules the site does — deliberately. The whole
claim of this entry point is that it drives the one runner, and a second
